headline: Satya Nadella says he’s AGI-pilled now
summary: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella believes in AGI's transformative power. He foresees major shifts in the global economy due to AI. Nadella questions how political economies will organize around AGI.

headline: Jeff Bezos says he was ‘heavily involved’ in picking the new James Bond
summary: Robert Pattinson has been cast as the new James Bond. Amazon founder Jeff Bezos played a significant role in the casting decision. Bezos confirmed his heavy involvement at a recent conference.

headline: Nvidia’s board chair speaks on Jensen Huang after resignation
summary: Nvidia's board chair, Harvey C. Jones, addressed Jensen Huang's resignation. Huang stepped down last week amid reports of multiple affairs. Colette Kress now leads the company as interim CEO and CFO.

headline: iFixit teardown: Apple HomeView is difficult to repair
summary: iFixit found Apple's new HomeView hub challenging to repair. Unlike recent iPads and HomePods, disassembly was much harder. The device's integrated design hinders easy access for repairs.

headline: Target reveals Black Friday sale dates
summary: Target announced its Black Friday sale dates. The retailer will offer free gift cards for in-store purchases. Specific deals are expected to be unveiled soon.

headline: Miami Heat unveils GTA 6 Vice City court
summary: The NBA's Miami Heat revealed a special Vice City-themed court. They will play on it for one night against the Milwaukee Bucks. The court design references the upcoming Grand Theft Auto 6.

headline: GTA 6 fans baffled by Jason actor's Game Awards snub
summary: GTA 6 fans are surprised and confused. The actor playing character Jason was not nominated at The Game Awards. The snub has sparked widespread discussion and debate.

headline: Baseus 20,000mAh power bank drops to $21
summary: The Baseus 20,000mAh 45W power bank is now available for $21. The deal includes dual USB-C cables. It can charge devices like Nintendo Switch 2 or Steam Deck during gameplay.

headline: Government backs welfare shake-up to prevent 'lost generation'
summary: The government supports a welfare system overhaul to prevent a 'lost generation'. Ex-minister Alan Milburn proposed diverting funds from benefits to job support. Plans aim to help young people into employment.

headline: Young people struggle to find jobs, BBC reports
summary: Young people share their difficulties in securing employment. A government-backed review aims to help young individuals find work. Many express frustration and struggle to maintain motivation.

headline: Nvidia won't reinstate Huang, reports strong earnings
summary: Nvidia confirmed it will not reinstate former CEO Jensen Huang. The AI chip giant announced robust quarterly earnings. This follows Huang's dramatic departure from the company.

headline: US soldier held by UK police for spying now in US custody
summary: An American soldier was arrested by UK police on suspicion of spying. The Metropolitan Police transferred him to US military custody. He faces allegations related to national security and espionage.
